Flavonoids contribute to the plant's ability to neutralize free radicals and promote tissue repair. Together, these bioactive components support the healing process and alleviate ulcer-related symptoms.
benefits.study: According to "Chemical & pharmaceutical bulletin", Zingiber officinale, the document below mainly talks about the isolation of anti-ulcer constituents from Zingiber officinale and their potential to cure stomach ulcers, mentioning that 6-gingesulfonic acid showed more potent anti-ulcer activity than 6-gingerol and 6-shogaol.

intro: Zingiber officinale, commonly known as ginger, is a versatile plant with numerous health benefits that can significantly improve everyday life. It is well known for its ability to alleviate nausea and motion sickness, making it a go-to remedy for morning sickness during pregnancy or after surgery. Ginger also possesses strong anti-inflammatory properties that can help reduce muscle pain, joint stiffness, and even symptoms of arthritis. Additionally, it supports digestive health by easing bloating, indigestion, and promoting regular bowel movements, contributing to overall wellness and comfort in daily routines.
